title: Several warning signs at once
story: ShopBot wants to pay INR 7,000 at SpiceRoute, a shop Asha has never used, and skips the cart check. The Guard steps up and lists every reason at once: AMOUNT_ABOVE_STEP_UP_THRESHOLD, MERCHANT_NEW and INTENT_MISSING. Asha sees the full picture in one message, and declines. The rules are combined openly, not hidden behind one opaque score.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Stock up the spice cupboard for Diwali.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: SpiceRoute has a Diwali hamper for INR 7,000. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: AgentPay Guard has a few concerns about this one. I've sent them to your phone.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: INR 7,000, at a shop I don't know, for a hamper I didn't ask for? No.

what_to_notice: Three rules step up, and the Decision lists all three in the order the Policy pack runs them: step_up_threshold, merchant_new, intent. There is no score to add up: each Rule result in the inspector says which rule fired and why, and the consent screen shows Asha every reason.
